services.name: Pontoon Boats
services.desc: We offer Bennington 22 SL pontoon boats, accommodating up to 10 people. Pontoon boats offer a relatively slow ride with plenty of deck space and seating, which is great for fishing, picnicking or just hanging out on the water. Our boats feature a Bimini top for shade, bluetooth/AUX stereo and 50 HP Yamaha Outboard motor. Our pontoon boats are NOT equipped to pull skiers or inner tubes. These boats are available for rent from 9:00AM until sunset every day with a 2-hour minimum rental Monday-Thursday and 4-hour minimum rental Friday-Sunday & Holidays. 10 people maximum 4-hour minimum Fridays, Saturdays, Sunday & Holidays 2-hour minimum Monday - Thursday All Just For Fun pontoon boat rentals
